remaining_blockers.title: No executable formal R067d runner consumes the configuration and performs the actual spawn.
evidence: future_runner.py lines 1-19 labels itself a non-executing seam and contains no subprocess.Popen or equivalent spawn.
future_runner.prestart_service only returns argv after a probe; no caller uses it.
r067d_cpu_prep.py lines 147-160 FILEdry writes configuration, copied old tooling, no_start.json, and a receipt only.
remaining_blockers.impact: The required formal-spawn connection and FILEdry of the formal path cannot be claimed.

remaining_blockers.title: The CPU replay parser is not bound to an actual runner log-consumer path.
evidence: validate_window and parse_rows appear only in r067d_cpu_prep.py lines 66-76 and the local test.
future_runner.py imports neither parser and does not read service windows, so it cannot establish that runtime acceptance uses the reviewed parser.
remaining_blockers.impact: Passing the replay unit test proves the preparation function only, not the runtime producer-to-consumer criterion required by the directive and the standing rule.

remaining_blockers.title: argv is not generated from immutable launch inputs and proven equal to the vector passed to spawn.
evidence: r067d_cpu_prep.py lines 23-28 clones serialized service['argv'] and patches only the startup path and API port.
future_runner.py lines 10-15 calls this function but never reaches spawn; no test establishes the vector passed to Popen, because no Popen path exists.
remaining_blockers.impact: The stale-digest test is useful but does not satisfy the required same-function actual-spawn proof.

remaining_blockers.title: Port probing is not exercised through a formal start attempt or diagnostic-order test.
evidence: The 120-second probe exists at r067d_cpu_prep.py lines 78-106 but only the non-executing future_runner calls it.
No test forces bind failure and verifies port-scoped ss/lsof artifacts exist before failed_harness.
remaining_blockers.impact: The directive's pre-start and failure-order requirement remains unproved.

remaining_blockers.title: Required Linux FT-venv CPU full-suite and formal FILEdry evidence is still absent.
evidence: The observed check is local Windows pytest only: 4 passed in 0.23s.
The local receipt still declares service_started=false, gpu_started=false, and http_generation=false, but it does not exercise a formal runner path.
remaining_blockers.impact: Directive item 4 has not been independently demonstrated.

admission_gate: Remain CPU-preparation-only. Require an executable, source-bound formal runner; same-function actual argv-to-spawn proof; parser-to-runtime consumer proof; start-path bind failure evidence; Linux FT-venv full-suite; and formal 10-service/14-call FILEdry before another independent admission review.
